question.label: Daily Test · Topic tag
title: Write your
own answer.
question.subtitle: Five questions. One small daily habit.
question.reason: Shows the real written Daily Test question and topic tag after the feedback and hint benefits.

hint.label: Topic hint · Held open
title: See the
grammar pattern.
hint.subtitle: Slide to reveal a topic reminder.
hint.reason: Shows 1.3.0's new slider and the complete topic card. Describes general patterns without promising an answer reveal.

home.label: Home · Glacier & Fox
title: Watch your
progress climb.
home.subtitle: A new mountain each month. A step each day.
alternatives: Climb a new mountain each month.
home.reason: Brings the product's distinctive Glacier scene, Fox and meaningful monthly progress into the first three.

results.label: Results · Correct & needs work
title: Every answer
explained.
results.subtitle: Your answer, the correction and the reason.
results.reason: Leads with the learning payoff: the same tense question, its wrong answer, correction and explanation, followed by a correct answer.

review.label: Review · Weak spots
title: Your weak spots,
in one place.
review.subtitle: See the grammar that keeps coming back.
review.reason: Connects the test to the real saved error list and recurrence counts.

collection.label: Profile · Medal collection
title: Build your
mountain collection.
collection.subtitle: Keep the medals you earn along the way.
collection.reason: Completes the monthly progression story with the app's actual earned medals.

onboarding.label: Onboarding · Fox selected
title: Pick your
learning companion.
onboarding.subtitle: Meet your Fox. Make your first step.
onboarding.reason: Shows the real avatar picker with fictional Sam and Fox, without implying goal-based lesson personalization.

multi-blank.label: Articles · Multiple blanks
title: One box for
every blank.
multi-blank.subtitle: Match each color. Tap — for no article.
multi-blank.reason: Eighth image: the real build-6 PracticeScreen with a local two-blank article fixture, colour-linked boxes and the working no-article control.
